№1.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your favorite hobby. In your essay, you should write about: what your hobby is, why you like it, and how often you do it.
№1.sovol_uz: Sevimli mashg‘ulotingiz haqida kichik insho yozing. Inshoda quyidagilar haqida yozing: mashg‘ulotingiz nima, nima uchun yoqtirasiz, va uni qanchalik tez-tez qilasiz.
№1.jovob_en: My favorite hobby is reading books. I like reading because it helps me learn new words and improve my English. It also makes me feel relaxed after a long day. I usually read short stories and interesting books. I read almost every day, especially in the evening.
№1.jovob_uz: Mening sevimli mashg‘ulotim kitob o‘qish. Men uni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki u yangi so‘zlarni o‘rganishga va ingliz tilimni yaxshilashga yordam beradi. Shuningdek, u meni tinchlantiradi. Men deyarli har kuni, ayniqsa kechqurun kitob o‘qiyman.

№2.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your family. In your essay, you should write about: the people in your family, what they do, and how you spend time together.
№2.sovol_uz: Oilangiz haqida kichik insho yozing. Inshoda quyidagilar haqida yozing: oilangiz a’zolari, ular nima ish qiladi yoki nimani yoqtiradi, va birga vaqtni qanday o‘tkazasiz.
№2.jovob_en: There are five people in my family: my father, my mother, my brother, my sister, and me. My father works in an office, and my mother is a teacher. My brother likes football, and my sister enjoys drawing. In the evening, we have dinner together and talk.
№2.jovob_uz: Mening oilamda besh kishi bor: otam, onam, akam, singlim va men. Otam ofisda ishlaydi, onam o‘qituvchi. Akam futbolni yaxshi ko‘radi, singlim rasm chizadi. Kechqurun birga ovqatlanib suhbatlashamiz.

№3.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your school. In your essay, you should write about: your classmates, your school teachers, and the buildings.
№3.sovol_uz: Maktabinggiz haqida kichik insho yozing. Inshoda quyidagilar haqida yozing: sinfdoshlaringiz, o‘qituvchilaringiz va maktab binolari.
№3.jovob_en: I study at a big school. My classmates are friendly and helpful. We study and play together. My teachers are kind and explain lessons clearly. Our school has a large building, a library, and sports stadiums. I like my school very much.
№3.jovob_uz: Men katta maktabda o‘qiyman. Sinfdoshlarim do‘stona va yordam beradi. Biz birga o‘qiymiz va o‘ynaymiz. O‘qituvchilarim mehribon. Maktabimizda katta bino va sport maydonlari bor. Men maktabimni yaxshi ko‘raman.

№4.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your favourite holiday. In your essay, you should write about: why you like it, the food you make, and what you do on that day.
№4.sovol_uz: Sevimli bayramingiz haqida kichik insho yozing. Inshoda quyidagilar haqida yozing: nima uchun yoqtirasiz, qanday ovqat tayyorlaysiz va o‘sha kuni nima qilasiz.
№4.jovob_en: My favourite holiday is Eid. I like it because I can spend time with my family. We cook traditional food like plov and sweets. We visit relatives and say kind words to each other. I feel very happy and excited on this day.
№4.jovob_uz: Mening sevimli bayramim Hayit. Men uni yaxshi ko‘raman, chunki oilam bilan vaqt o‘tkazaman. Biz palov va shirinliklar tayyorlaymiz. Qarindoshlarni ko‘ramiz va yaxshi tilaklar aytamiz. Bu kun meni xursand qiladi.

№5.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your city. In your essay, you should write about: the markets, the parks, and the buildings.
№5.sovol_uz: Shahringiz haqida kichik insho yozing. Inshoda quyidagilar haqida yozing: bozorlar, bog‘lar va binolar.
№5.jovob_en: I live in a beautiful city. There are many markets with fresh fruits and vegetables. The parks are green and clean. Families walk and relax there. There are tall buildings, schools, and shops. I like my city because it is peaceful and comfortable.
№5.jovob_uz: Men chiroyli shaharda yashayman. Bu yerda yangi meva va sabzavotlar sotiladigan ko‘plab bozorlar bor. Bog‘lar yashil va toza. Odamlar u yerda dam oladi. Baland binolar va do‘konlar bor. Men shahrimni yaxshi ko‘raman.

№6.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your last birthday. In your essay, you should write about: when it was, who was there, and what happened.
№6.sovol_uz: Oxirgi tug‘ilgan kuningiz haqida kichik insho yozing. Inshoda quyidagilar haqida yozing: qachon bo‘lgan, kimlar bor edi va nima bo‘lgan.
№6.jovob_en: My last birthday was in July. I celebrated it at home with my family and friends. We ate delicious food and a big cake. My friends gave me presents. We talked, laughed, and took photos. It was a very happy day.
№6.jovob_uz: Oxirgi tug‘ilgan kunim iyul oyida bo‘ldi. Men uni uyda oilam va do‘stlarim bilan nishonladim. Biz mazali ovqat va katta tort yedik. Do‘stlarim sovg‘a berdi. Bu juda baxtli kun edi.

№7.sovol_en: Write a small essay about a place you like. In your essay, you should write about: where the place is, what you can see there, and what you do there.
№7.sovol_uz: Yoqtirgan joyingiz haqida kichik insho yozing. Inshoda quyidagilar haqida yozing: u qayerda joylashgan, u yerda nimani ko‘rish mumkin va u yerda nima qilasiz.
№7.jovob_en: One place I like is the park near my house. It is close to my home. There are many trees and flowers. I can see children playing and families walking. I go there to relax and breathe fresh air.
№7.jovob_uz: Men yoqtiradigan joylardan biri uyim yaqinidagi bog‘. U uyimga yaqin. U yerda ko‘plab daraxtlar va gullar bor. Bolalar o‘ynaydi, oilalar sayr qiladi. Men u yerga dam olish uchun boraman.

№8.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your house or flat. In your essay, you should write about: how many rooms it has, your favorite room, and what you like about your house or flat.
№8.sovol_uz: Uyingiz yoki kvartirangiz haqida kichik insho yozing. Inshoda quyidagilar haqida yozing: nechta xona bor, sevimli xonangiz va uyingizning nimasi yoqadi.
№8.jovob_en: I live in a comfortable house. It has four rooms: a living room, two bedrooms, and a kitchen. My favorite room is my bedroom because I can study and rest there. I like my house because it is clean and quiet.
№8.jovob_uz: Men qulay uyda yashayman. Unda to‘rtta xona bor: mehmonxona, ikkita yotoqxona va oshxona. Mening sevimli xonam yotoqxonam. U yerda o‘qiyman va dam olaman. Uylim toza va tinch.

№9.sovol_en: Write a small essay about yourself. In your essay, you should write about: your name and age, where you are from, and your hobbies.
№9.sovol_uz: O‘zingiz haqida kichik insho yozing. Inshoda quyidagilar haqida yozing: ismingiz va yoshingiz, qayerdansiz va mashg‘ulotlaringiz.
№9.jovob_en: My name is Elyor, and I am a university student. I am from Uzbekistan. I am friendly and hardworking. In my free time, I like reading books and learning English. I also enjoy listening to music.
№9.jovob_uz: Mening ismim Elyor, men universitet talabasisiman. Men O‘zbekistondanman. Men do‘stona va mehnatsevarman. Bo‘sh vaqtimda kitob o‘qishni va ingliz tilini o‘rganishni yaxshi ko‘raman.

№10.sovol_en: Write a small essay about your favorite thing. In your essay, you should write about: what it is, who gave it to you or where you got it, and why you like it.
№10.sovol_uz: Sevimli narsangiz haqida kichik insho yozing. Inshoda quyidagilar haqida yozing: u nima, kim bergan yoki qayerdan olgansiz va nima uchun yoqtirasiz.
№10.jovob_en: My favorite thing is my smartphone. I bought it last year with my own money. I use it to study English and talk to my friends. It helps me in my daily life. I like it because it is very useful.
№10.jovob_uz: Mening sevimli narsam smartfonim. Uni o‘tgan yili o‘z pulimga sotib oldim. Men undan ingliz tilini o‘rganish va do‘stlarim bilan gaplashish uchun foydalanaman. U juda foydali.
